title: Biotech firms are meant to pay to use Earth’s genetic data. They’re not.
title_zh: 生物技术公司本应为使用地球基因数据付费，但并未支付
abstract: Global leaders at the COP17 biodiversity summit complained that companies using public genetic data are not paying into a voluntary fund to protect nature.
abstract_zh: 在联合国生物多样性大会COP17上，全球领导人抱怨使用公共基因数据的公司并未向自愿性自然保护基金付款。
snippet: Global leaders at the COP17 biodiversity summit complained that companies using public genetic data are not paying into a voluntary fund to protect nature.
